description: This PHP class provides base64 encoding and decoding functionalities as part of a SourceMap utility in the SCSSPHP project. It encodes integers into base64 characters and decodes base64 characters back into integers, which are used for source map position mappings.

classes.name: Base64
classes.description: A utility class for encoding integers to base64 characters and decoding base64 characters to integers within the source map context.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes an integer value (0-63) into its corresponding base64 character.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a base64 character into its corresponding integer value (0-63).
